openPoints.item: Exact application permission code required to call POST /core-asks (e.g. ASK.CREATE) is not defined in the specification.
Definition of leadership-group membership used to route SUBMIT to statusId 145 vs 127 — which role(s) or group(s) qualify — is not specified.
Exact reference IDs for the 'first option' of needReasonId and generalSpecialityNeedId that trigger clearing rules (BR4, BR5) are not defined.
Exact reference IDs constituting the 'top-3 set' for levelNeedId that make rolePostingId mandatory (BR13) are not defined.
File-upload contract for the documents field (MIME types, size limits, number of files, multipart vs base64 encoding) is represented only as 'file upload array' in the specification.
openPoints.resolution: Documents are uploaded separately through the platform document upload endpoint defined in HLD §13.1. The documents field in this request should reference existing document IDs, not carry file bytes. Type: array of string (document IDs). Applied API Design Standards document upload pattern.

openPoints.item: Whether a client-supplied idempotency key is required to prevent duplicate ASK creation on retry is not addressed in the specification.
openPoints.resolution: API Design Standards §6 REL 001 requires Idempotency-Key header for workflow decisions and retry-sensitive commands. POST /core-asks creates a workflow instance and is retry-sensitive. Resolution: Idempotency-Key header is required.

openPoints.item: Transaction scope — whether Ask, AskVersion, WorkflowTask, AskComment, AskAttachmentLink and OutboxMessage must all commit in a single SaveChangesAsync, or whether attachment handling is deferred — is explicitly noted as unconfirmed in the specification.
openPoints.resolution: HLD §8.3 point 46 and §10.1 require transactional outbox pattern. All workflow state changes, task assignment, audit history and outbox records commit in one Azure SQL transaction. Resolution: All entities commit in a single SaveChangesAsync.

openPoints.item: Outbox event type, version, minimal payload, recipient rule and template key for the WorkflowTaskCreated event emitted on SUBMIT are not defined.
BU scope rule — which BusinessUnit(s) the caller must belong to in order to create a Core ASK — is not specified.
Whether needReasonId = retirement exempts endDate entirely or only from the 'must be after projectedStartDate' rule is ambiguous in the specification.
Meaning and intended cardinality of the duplicate numberofresources key in the request/response schema
Whether fYear and regionId are required or optional, and their validation rules
numberofresources field appears twice in the request and response schema with different values (1 and 2)
fYear and regionId present in the API Details request schema but not listed in Functional Requirements field list
Workflow status IDs 123, 127, 145 used in routing rules

blocked.reason: Specification uses HTTP 422 for business validation failures but MLLD 12.2 defines only 400 validation_failed. Conflict must be resolved before error contract can be finalised.
Specification defines POST /core-asks but MLLD 15 proposed catalogue defines POST /api/v1/asks. Path and type-discriminator approach must be confirmed.
Request and response schemas contain a duplicate field numberofresources. This specification defect must be resolved.
